findings.before: Ancestor color overrides broke dark hero paragraphs and light controls.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Low-priority surface defaults; component utilities own foregrounds. Real and nested-surface contrast checks pass.

findings.before: Drawer and owner breakpoints differed; desktop resize retained scroll lock.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Aligned 1180px cutoff; resize cleanup; close only on actual route change. First-click, Escape/focus and resize checks pass.

findings.before: Link compressed titles; carousel targets clipped at mobile widths.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Stacked title/link; small markers inside 44px controls; selection and bounds assertions pass.

findings.before: Breadcrumb compressed Home onto multiple lines.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Wrapping groups and nonshrinking separators; readable foreground.

findings.before: Ongoing statistic exceeded its mobile cell.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Responsive typography/gaps; per-element overflow assertions pass.

findings.before: Mixed light/dark styles hid form text; URL label lacked input association.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Readable header/cards/input, associated label, pressed states and compact labels. API generation/state/clipboard handlers preserved.

findings.before: Directory initialization failure removed public page body.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Logged explicit unavailable state retains page/contact path; successful loader and authorization unchanged. Both states tested.

findings.before: Portrait placement showed a group-training asset.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Existing organization.founder.imagePath restores the canonical portrait; repository asset and rendered result inspected.

findings.before: Blue-100 intro against blue-600 had only 4.24:1 contrast.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: White intro minimum 5.17:1; darker badge/CTA backing; rendered contrast assertion passes.

findings.before: Small green links and bright hover colors lacked contrast.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Green-800 labels and deeper ROI hover color; prices/funding wording unchanged; rendered contrast assertion passes.

findings.before: A cold GitHub browser render focused the CNA selector but retained HVAC content: a control accepted activation before its client handler was ready.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Selection controls are disabled until hydration enables their handlers. Two regression tests cover server-rendered readiness and the first ready activation. The real browser suite retains its selection, destination, image decoding and geometry assertions.

findings.before: Production-mode Axe reported 2.45:1–3.29:1 contrast for Aligned with, Elevate Internal Training, How You Can Start and the funding step label across five public routes.
findings.correctionAndEvidence: Scoped slate-600 and green-800 component utilities replace low-contrast label colors. Accessibility scans now also require a successful HTTP response and visible main/heading so an error page cannot count as route verification. Existing Axe severity assertions remain unchanged.
